mapper.select: select id,media_type as mediaType,review_state as reviewState,review_reason as reviewReason, update_time as updatedAt from app_media_asset where owner_type='APP' and member_id=#{memberId} order by id desc limit 50

select id,media_type as mediaType,review_state as reviewState,review_reason as reviewReason, update_time as updatedAt from app_media_asset where owner_type='APP' and member_id=#{memberId} and id < #{beforeId} order by id desc limit 50

select id,member_id as memberId,object_key as objectKey,media_type as mediaType,review_state as reviewState, review_reason as reviewReason,version,audit_task_id as auditTaskId,owner_type as ownerType,storage_type as storageType,public_url as publicUrl from app_media_asset where object_key=#{objectKey}

select id,member_id as memberId,object_key as objectKey,media_type as mediaType,review_state as reviewState, review_reason as reviewReason,version,audit_task_id as auditTaskId,owner_type as ownerType,storage_type as storageType,public_url as publicUrl from app_media_asset where id=#{id}

select id,member_id as memberId,object_key as objectKey,media_type as mediaType,review_state as reviewState, review_reason as reviewReason,version,audit_task_id as auditTaskId,owner_type as ownerType,storage_type as storageType,public_url as publicUrl from app_media_asset where id=#{id} for update
mapper.update: update app_media_asset set audit_task_id=#{taskId},update_time=now() where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and review_state='HOLD' and audit_task_id is null
update app_media_asset set review_state=#{state},review_reason=#{reason},update_time=now() where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and review_state='HOLD' and audit_task_id=#{taskId}

update app_media_asset set review_state='HOLD',review_reason=null,version=version+1,audit_task_id=null,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and member_id=#{memberId} and version=#{version} and review_state in ('REJECTED','UNAVAILABLE')
